audit.why: TRICKY 7/10 matches: early lane is even, but Death From Below execute resets turn Soraka's own heals into free kills once Pyke hits 6, so it stays hard through items.

audit.whatIsWrong: All 7 level-chart rows disagreed between layers: phases[0-3].side said Pyke while win[0-3] content said Skill, and phases[4-6].side said Skill while win[4-6] content said Pyke.
audit.why: Content whys[] already ground this correctly: neither side has kill pressure without a landed hook pre-6, but Death From Below (R, 100/85/70s) executes and resets on kills and Soraka's own heal can push an ally into that execute band, so post-6 flips to Pyke.
audit.corrected: Realigned all 7 phases[N].side to match win[N] and rewrote the matching why-text and ratings for each.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three missingInteractions were absent from the page: Pyke bypasses stacked resistances (Gift of the Drowned Ones), Ghostwater Dive (W) camo needs Control Wards/sweeper since Soraka has no reveal, and Bone Skewer (Q) is an interruptible channel Equinox (E) cancels outright.
audit.why: These change concrete build and cooldown decisions, not just flavor text.
audit.corrected: Added resistances and stealth points to report[8]/report[5], and the channel-interrupt to breakdown.cooldowns.

edits.before: - Pyke Bone Skewer: matchup-defining — The hook starts the chain — his R cleans what it catches. The duo’s tempo bends around it. - Keep E Equinox banked for their best play. - The ultimate is a fight decision, not a habit.
edits.after: - Pyke Bone Skewer: 10/9.5/9/8.5/8s CD — the hook starts the chain, his R cleans what it catches. It's a channel, so Equinox (E, 20/19/18/17/16s CD) cancels it outright if you catch the cast. - His R is 100/85/70s — a fight decision, not a habit.

edits.before: Q the refill, W the carry, repeat — the battery economy runs while their math wonders why nothing dies.
edits.after: Once the hook whiffs or lands on a minion, his combo is dead for the full cooldown — step up and refill immediately.

edits.before: Healing into a full rotation with the bank empty — Soraka without Q refills is a donation with a horn.
edits.after: A topped-up ally can still fall inside Death From Below's execute band — don't heal someone into hook range just to feed the reset.

edits.before: Track Pyke’s Bone Skewer: The hook starts the chain — his R cleans what it catches. It’s down or you don’t go.
edits.after: Track Pyke’s Bone Skewer: The hook starts the chain — his R cleans what it catches. It's a channel, so Equinox cancels it outright. He's also invisible in Ghostwater Dive (W) with no built-in reveal on your kit, so Control Wards and a sweeper are mandatory.

edits.before: World Atlas start. Moonstone, Swiftness, Redemption-Mikael's — heal amps compound the battery. Add anti-heal early into his duo’s sustain.
edits.after: World Atlas start. Moonstone, Swiftness, Redemption-Mikael's — heal amps compound the battery. Add anti-heal early into his duo’s sustain; he bypasses stacked HP/armor (Gift of the Drowned Ones), so raw resistances alone don't answer him.

edits.before: Starcall the contacts — the self-heal funds the bank and the slow annoys their spacing.
edits.after: Level 1 is even — neither of you has hook range or kill pressure yet.

edits.before: W opens the battery: your carry's HP bar is now a shared account.
edits.after: Level 2 stays skill-based on whether he lands an early Bone Skewer hook.

edits.before: Equinox threats begin: the silence zone cancels engages mid-cast.
edits.after: Level 3 is a coin-flip decided by hook accuracy versus your poke.

edits.before: Heal the margins and Q the refills — the battery economy runs the lane.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 stay even as long as you deny the pull from behind minions.

edits.before: Wish online — every all-in on the map gets a second health bar.
edits.after: Death From Below executes and resets off kills, and topping an ally into that threshold hands him free gold — this window flips to him.

edits.before: First item: the heals compound and the silence zones decide dives.
edits.after: Lethality makes his hook-into-execute chain unhealable — respect his roams under Ghostwater Dive.

edits.before: Late Soraka is the global bank: wish the map, silence the dives, and outlast every ledger.
edits.after: His R ignores raw healing and roam picks snowball all game — prevention beats out-healing here.

notes: packet defect also flagged zero sequencing cues — added concrete cooldown numbers (Q 10/9.5/9/8.5/8s, R 100/85/70s) and the channel-cancel window into breakdown.cooldowns and report[5] to cover it.
